speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Hodgkin Lymphoma. The combination of B symptoms (night sweats, weight loss), elevated LDH, and massive mediastinal lymphadenopathy on the CT scan is highly characteristic of this condition. Given the enlarged supraclavicular node initially noted, I recommend proceeding with a lymph node biopsy for confirmation and staging.
